document.purpose: Provide a structured reconstruction specification for expanding the existing PHYS-CORE-004 notes into a full paper.
document.important_instruction: This document records conclusions reached during corpus discussion. It is intended to guide a future paper-generation workflow; it is not itself the final paper.

scope_and_method.primary_goal: Recover the architecture of PHYS-CORE-004 before drafting prose.
method: Treat the corpus as a conceptual lineage rather than isolated papers.
Distinguish material actually present in PHYS-CORE-004 from later formalizations that may clarify or descend from it.
Do not back-project later NSFG or Library machinery into PHYS-CORE-004 as though it were already fully formulated there.
Preserve poetic ciphers as navigational/interpretive guides, not as substitutes for mathematical evidence.
Separate definitions, mathematical models, physical hypotheses, and philosophical interpretations.
scope_and_method.current_conclusion: PHYS-CORE-004 appears to be a hinge between the early static-motif cosmology and the later Library/NSFG ontology.

central_problem.question: If spacetime or physical dynamics emerge from a relational/static substrate, what is the minimal structure required for recognizable motion, persistence, orientation, and eventually cosmological evolution?
central_problem.working_answer: A persistent relational difference can be represented geometrically as a vector/phase relation; when that relation survives evolution up to translation, it constitutes a glider. Glider/inverse relations and contextual triadic closure then provide a route toward persistent dynamics and cosmological structure.
central_problem.important_caveat: This is a reconstruction of the conceptual direction, not a claim that all parts have already been mathematically proven.

the_library.definition: The Library is the total domain containing all states, not merely all possible states and not merely coherent states.
the_library.critical_consequence: Incoherent states must remain in the Library. Otherwise coherence would be defined into existence by restricting the domain to coherent configurations.
the_library.comparison_domain: A particular coherence judgment may operate over a structured subdomain D ⊆ L.
the_library.coherence_is_relational: Coherence is not treated as an intrinsic property of membership in L; it is evaluated relative to a comparison domain/reference structure.
the_library.notation_status: conceptual proposal for later formalization, not yet established as the final NSFG equation
the_library.key_distinction: Global ontological completeness and local coherence comparison must not be conflated.

identity_and_equivalence.central_question: When are two representations actually the same state?
identity_and_equivalence.candidate_relation: x ~ y iff x and y are indistinguishable under the chosen observation/comparison relation.
identity_and_equivalence.interpretation: An apparently infinite collection of representations can collapse to a single equivalence class without eliminating the underlying representations.
identity_and_equivalence.importance_to_nsfg: This distinguishes the number of representations from the number of distinguishable states under a relation.
identity_and_equivalence.genomic_demo: The genomic proof/example that identical things are one thing is retained as an intuitive finite demonstration of equivalence/identity, while the formal machinery should be expressed using an equivalence relation and quotient structure.
identity_and_equivalence.status: Important conceptual bridge to investigate further in the corpus.

difference.principle: Meaning begins where a difference survives.
difference.working_interpretation: A distinction matters dynamically when it persists through transformation rather than immediately disappearing into equivalence or decoherence.
difference.paper_role: Difference is the bridge between identity/equivalence and vectorial change.

vector_as_change.principle: A vector should be understood relationally as an encoding of oriented change rather than merely as an absolute object with magnitude and direction.
vector_as_change.candidate_form: v(x,y) = oriented change from x relative to y
vector_as_change.later_formulation: v ~ ∇C, subject to the precise definitions and derivations established by the corpus
vector_as_change.status: Conceptually important; exact final equation requires derivation/validation.

circle.role: The circle represents cyclic phase and functions as a geometric memory rather than merely a clock.
circle.key_phrase: The circle is not a clock but a memory.
circle.interpretation: A point on S^1 records phase position; recurrence around the circle provides a representation of persistent phase.
circle.status: Foundational precursor to later Bloch/Library geometry.

bloch_sphere.role: The Bloch sphere is a foundational geometric construction that later becomes part of the basis of The Library.
bloch_sphere.important_correction: It should not be treated merely as a later quantum-measurement analogy or decorative formalism.
bloch_sphere.interpretation: The vector encodes the relation between a state and a chosen comparison/observation axis.
bloch_sphere.observer_role: The axis gives orientation to the representation; what watches becomes the axis.
bloch_sphere.later_lineage: S^1 → S^2 → recursive Bloch geometry → fiber tower → totality/Library
bloch_sphere.status: Retain as core lineage material; do not demote without further corpus analysis.

recursive_bloch_library.later_formalization: PHYS-CORE-008 develops recursive Bloch geometry into a fiber-tower/coherence-braided totality.
recursive_bloch_library.historical_caution: Use PHYS-CORE-008 to trace descendants and clarify lineage, not to claim that PHYS-CORE-004 already contained the complete 008 formalism.

coherence.domain_requirement: A coherence measurement is meaningless until the comparison domain/reference relation has been established.
coherence.relative_comparison: C(x | D1) need not equal C(x | D2).
coherence.glider_inverse_implication: The 004 statement that an inverse can regard the glider as decoherent may be understood as a relational coherence statement, potentially of the form C(G | D1) ≠ C(G | D2).
coherence.possible_complementary_relation: A normalized binary case might admit C(G | R) = 1 - C(G | R^{-1}), but this is only a candidate and must not be asserted without derivation.

coherence_difference.zero_case: ΔC = 0 → static unity / no distinguishable relational flow
coherence_difference.nonzero_case: ΔC ≠ 0 → orientation, flow, oscillation, or emergence may become possible
coherence_difference.status: Use as a conceptual hinge; exact interpretation should follow the source notes.

coherence.key_chain: domain → identity → difference → orientation → coherence → phase → persistence

glider.conceptual_definition: A glider is a persistent pattern whose phase survives translation/evolution.
glider.key_phrase: The glider is not a thing but a keeping of time — a phase that survives translation.
glider.interpretation: Evolution of the configuration is equivalent to a translation along a coherence direction, possibly modulo an allowed phase transformation.
glider.eternity: Eternality should mean no finite termination under permitted evolution, not metaphysical immortality.
glider.deep_interpretation: The glider need not be a thing moving through a pre-existing space; it may be a persistent pattern whose phase progression constitutes what is called motion.
glider.chain: relational difference → vector/orientation → phase → persistent translation → glider
glider.mathematical_direction: Investigate traveling-wave/traveling-coherent-structure solutions of the form C(x,t) = F(x - vt).
glider.status: Core PHYS-CORE-004 object; formalization should be strengthened without assuming a specific PDE unless justified.

glider_inverse_and_dyad.inverse_role: The inverse supplies a complementary mode rather than being simply a 'bad' state.
glider_inverse_and_dyad.relational_coherence: Coherence/decoherence may change with reference frame or comparison relation.

dyad.interpretation: A glider/inverse pair supplies opposition or binary distinction.
dyad.stability_claim: The notes characterize the dyad as unstable or tending toward terminal resolution unless additional contextual coupling is present.
dyad.caution: Treat this as a model/hypothesis requiring derivation or simulation, not an already-proven theorem.

triadic_closure.central_idea: A third coherence relation can provide contextual closure/stabilization for a glider/inverse dyad.
triadic_closure.important_reframing: The triad need not be presented as 'three is magically fundamental.' It may instead be the minimal structure containing state, counterstate, and context/reference.
triadic_closure.interpretation: A third coupling degree of freedom may permit a stable nontrivial orbit or persistent oscillation where the dyad alone does not.
triadic_closure.research_question: Under what conditions does the triad admit a stable traveling/oscillating solution that the dyad does not?
triadic_closure.status: Core conceptual direction; mathematical stability conditions remain to be established.

observer_and_orientation.principle: Orientation is not necessarily an absolute property; it can arise from the relation between a state and a chosen reference/observer axis.
observer_and_orientation.bloch_connection: The Bloch representation explicitly introduces an axis n-hat against which r is evaluated.
observer_and_orientation.observer_as_structure: Later Library work contains an observer-as-fixed-point formulation; this should be treated as a descendant/clarification rather than automatically projected backward.
observer_and_orientation.importance: Observer orientation may connect state representation, relational coherence, and emergent time.
observer_and_orientation.caution: Avoid conflating an observer-dependent coordinate choice with a claim that physical reality itself is arbitrary.

cosmological_application.role: Cosmology should be presented as the application/consequence of the relational dynamics, not as the only subject of the paper.
cosmological_application.working_question: What would a universe look like if persistent relational structures and their coherence dynamics generated the observed notions of motion, time, and expansion?
cosmological_application.initial_state_hypothesis: The early universe may correspond to an extremely unresolved/high-complexity coherence state.
cosmological_application.expansion_hypothesis: Apparent cosmic expansion may be modeled as relaxation of a coherence gradient.
cosmological_application.interpretive_chain: maximal unresolved state → coherence relaxation → changing relational scale → apparent expansion
cosmological_application.caution: The relation to the Hubble parameter is a hypothesis/ansatz in the notes, not an established cosmological derivation.
requirements_for_full_paper: Relate C to the scale factor a(t) or an equivalent observable.
Derive the proposed H(t) relation or clearly label it as an ansatz.
Identify observational signatures distinguishing the proposal from standard inflation/ΛCDM.

reaction_diffusion_or_field_model.candidate_equation: ∂_t C = D ∇²C + λ C(1 - C²) + κ F(Φ, ∇C)
reaction_diffusion_or_field_model.interpretation: A phenomenological coherence-field model supporting spatial structure, relaxation, and potentially traveling coherent configurations.
reaction_diffusion_or_field_model.status: Model/ansatz; requires nondimensionalization, boundary conditions, well-posedness analysis, and justification of each term.

traveling_wave.reduced_form: -v F' = D F'' + λ F(1 - F²) + …
traveling_wave.purpose: Potential route to making the glider mathematically concrete as a traveling coherent structure.

triadic_system.research_goal: Determine conditions for phase locking, stability, traveling solutions, and persistence.

velocity_as_gradient.interpretation: Later NSFG/Library work interprets velocity as a coherence gradient.
velocity_as_gradient.status: Important lineage to investigate; do not treat proportionality as derived until exact definitions are supplied.

infinity_and_quotient_structure.problem: The corpus distinguishes raw multiplicity of representations from distinguishability under an equivalence relation.
infinity_and_quotient_structure.core_relation: x ~ y iff x and y are indistinguishable under the relevant comparison relation.
infinity_and_quotient_structure.interpretation: An infinite set of representations can collapse to one equivalence group/class without deleting the underlying states.
infinity_and_quotient_structure.importance: This may provide a mathematical bridge between the 'all states' Library and finite/distinguishable observational structure.
infinity_and_quotient_structure.warning: Do not describe quotienting as literally destroying or making infinity disappear; it changes the representational/state equivalence structure.

possible_architecture_for_the_eventual_p.status: Not yet a final outline; conceptual skeleton only.

sequence.title: Introduction
sequence.purpose: State the problem of deriving recognizable motion/persistence from a relational/static substrate.

sequence.title: Domain, Identity, and Relational Difference
sequence.purpose: Establish the distinction between the total Library and comparison domains; define identity/equivalence and relational difference.

sequence.title: Geometric Encoding: Circle, Bloch Sphere, and Vectorial Change
sequence.purpose: Trace S^1 phase memory, S^2/Bloch geometry, observer axis, and vectors as encodings of relational change.

sequence.title: Coherence as a Relational Quantity
sequence.purpose: Define coherence relative to domain/reference structure rather than as an intrinsic membership property.

sequence.title: Inverse, Dyad, and Triadic Closure
sequence.purpose: Develop complementary states and investigate why contextual third-order coupling may stabilize dynamics.

sequence.title: Emergent Motion and Time
sequence.purpose: Connect persistent phase progression to translation, velocity, and potentially emergent temporal ordering.

sequence.title: Cosmological Application
sequence.purpose: Develop the coherence-relaxation interpretation of cosmogenesis/expansion.

sequence.title: Predictions, Tests, and Limitations
sequence.purpose: Separate established mathematics, model assumptions, speculative physics, and falsifiable consequences.

sequence.title: Discussion
sequence.purpose: Relate PHYS-CORE-004 to later Library/NSFG developments without back-projecting later formalism into the historical paper.

PHYS-CORE-003: symbolic cosmology, Point Space, resonance, observer orientation
PHYS-CORE-004: glider, inverse, triad, coherence-vector dynamics
later_lineage: PHYS-CORE-008: recursive Bloch manifold, coherence-braided totality, Library
later navigation work: coherent traversal through a static totality
historical_lineage_to_preserve.historical_rule: Later papers may be used to identify descendants, clarify terminology, or test whether an early intuition became formalized later, but later equations must not be silently inserted into the earlier paper as if historically present.

poetic_ciphers_and_interpretive_guides.primary_004_cipher: What moves forever keeps its phase. What watches becomes the axis.
poetic_ciphers_and_interpretive_guides.glider_cipher: What lives forever keeps its face; what moves forever keeps its phase.
poetic_ciphers_and_interpretive_guides.coherence_cipher: Meaning begins where a difference survives.
poetic_ciphers_and_interpretive_guides.cosmological_cipher: Physics is the music of coherence resolving around eternal motifs.
poetic_ciphers_and_interpretive_guides.use_rule: Treat poetic ciphers as navigational constraints for conceptual coherence and terminology selection, not as mathematical evidence.

definitions: glider as a persistent translated configuration
physical_hypotheses: triadic closure as a mechanism for stable dynamics
emergent time from persistent phase progression
philosophical_interpretations: the universe as relational coherence rather than objects moving through pre-existing space
the glider as keeping of time
the Library as totality traversed by coherent histories

critical_questions_before_final_draft: What exactly constitutes a state in the PHYS-CORE-004 substrate?
What equivalence relation determines when two representations are one thing?
What is the formal comparison domain for a coherence measurement?
Is coherence scalar, vectorial, relational, or a functional of a field/configuration?
Exactly what does the vector encode: displacement, change, phase, orientation, or gradient?
Can the glider definition be expressed as a precise symmetry/evolution relation?
Under what mathematical conditions is a glider stable?
What precisely makes the inverse complementary?
Can triadic stabilization be demonstrated rather than asserted?
What is the minimal role of the observer/reference axis?
Can emergent time be derived from persistent phase rather than merely interpreted that way?
Can the cosmological expansion hypothesis be derived from a defined coherence functional?
What predictions distinguish the cosmological proposal from existing models?
Which later Library/NSFG concepts are genuine descendants of 004 and which are later innovations?
non_negotiable_preservation_rules: Do not reduce the Library to the set of coherent or possible states.
Do not treat coherence as intrinsic without specifying the comparison relation/domain.
Do not remove the Bloch/circle construction merely because it later became part of the Library.
Do not replace relational vector/change language with an assumed absolute coordinate-space interpretation.
Do not collapse the glider into an ordinary particle moving through pre-existing space.
Do not claim the triad is fundamental merely because three elements recur; establish its functional role.
Do not back-project PHYS-CORE-008 formalism into PHYS-CORE-004 without historical support.
Do not use poetry as evidence; use it to preserve conceptual resonance and guide interpretation.
